Document with only script tags produces empty output (scripts are stripped)

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<html><head><script>alert('xss')</script></head><body><script>document.write('hello')</script></body></html>", options: _options)
print(result)
```
